name: record-trivia
description: Record & music trivia above the prompt while Claude works, with an optional feed from a Discord channel

discordBotToken.title: Discord bot token
discordBotToken.description: Bot token used to read trivia from a Discord channel. Leave empty to use the built-in deck only.

discordChannelId.title: Discord channel ID
discordChannelId.description: Channel to pull trivia from. Post lines like: !trivia Album | Artist | Year | Fact   or   !q Question | Answer

rotateSeconds.title: Seconds per card
rotateSeconds.description: How long each trivia card shows before the next one (the answer is revealed halfway).
